item.description:
### Fixed - **Opening Stats is fast again.** Perch keeps a cache of every transcript it has already counted, but a file it read and found nothing to count in, such as a subagent's transcript, was never added to it, so it was read again on every open. On a Mac with a long history that was 16 seconds of scanning each time; now it is a fraction of a second. A file Perch could not read is retried rather than remembered as empty.
### Added - **Read a long message in full on your phone.** A message or tool result the phone shows as truncated now offers "show the rest", and a tap fetches the whole thing from your Mac. Needs the next companion app update to appear; older phones keep the plain truncated note.
